Task Name: Init repo skeleton and Go module
Description: Layout per D-032: cmd/konku, internal/{card,srs,auth,store,api,config}, migrations, web. go.mod, Makefile, .gitignore, linter config. CI grep asserting card and srs import nothing from internal/.
Self-contained: pgvector/pgvector:pg17 on port 5433, app service, named volume. git clone && docker compose up must work. Also what CI uses.

users, sessions, domains, notes, cards, card_schedules, review_logs, focus_sessions. user_id denormalized onto every owned table from THIS migration (D-039). Generated tsvector on notes. review_logs must exist now - retention cannot be reconstructed retroactively (D-029).

Task Name: Config loading and DB connection pool caps
Description: DATABASE_URL, port, session secret, ALLOW_SIGNUP from env. SetMaxOpenConns(10) - Go defaults to unlimited and one app can starve every project on the shared Postgres (D-028).
PURE - no DB, no HTTP imports. Intervals [1,3,7,14,30,90,180]. NextSchedule, DueCards (capped ~10, oldest-first), mastered terminal state. Local YYYY-MM-DD dates, never UTC.

Task Name: Markdown card parser with stable IDs
Description: PURE. MVP parses `Q :: A` ONLY - cloze and feynman are v0.2. Owns both directions: Parse(md) and Insert(md, card) (D-033). Assigns IDs and writes them back as <!-- c:xxxx -->. Matching by content would destroy review history on a typo fix (D-019). Highest correctness risk in the project.

Diff parsed cards against DB BY ID ONLY. New ID inserts at stage 0; existing ID updates content and leaves the schedule untouched; vanished ID soft-deletes. Note update and card sync commit in ONE transaction.
POST/GET/PATCH /api/notes. PATCH triggers card sync. Tool-shaped from the start - same operations later serve MCP and an in-app assistant (D-017).

internal/auth. argon2id hashing (golang.org/x/crypto/argon2), sessions table in Postgres (revocable - logout actually logs out), middleware resolving session to userID in request context. Rate-limit login: the only unauthenticated write path. Rejected: signed cookies, not revocable.

Task Name: Scope every store method by user_id
Description: Every store method takes a userID parameter - none callable without one. Ownership in the WHERE clause, never fetch-then-check, so a wrong owner gets 'not found' and cannot probe whether another user's note exists (D-039).
cmd/konku seed-user creates the first account. No public signup in the MVP - registration behind ALLOW_SIGNUP, default off. Correct default for a self-hosted box regardless of intent.
Minimal. Indonesian copy, plain and direct.
GET /api/review/due - capped ~10, oldest-due first. Returns the prompt side ONLY so the client cannot leak the answer before reveal.
POST /api/review/:cardId with ingat/lupa. Reschedules via srs and writes a review_logs row on EVERY review (D-029).

Task Name: React scaffold, note list and editor
Description: Vite + TS + Tailwind, embedded via go:embed. Note list and note editor (textarea + markdown preview). No CodeMirror - deliberately undersized until the friction is felt rather than imagined (D-018).

Task Name: Review screen with recall before reveal
Description: Prompt only, then reveal, then ingat/lupa. The hidden answer is MANDATORY - showing it immediately makes this passive re-reading, which GOALS.md says does not work (D-003). Link back to the source note.
15/20/25/30/45 min, default 20, short durations first on purpose. Start/pause/reset. Works offline - client-side only.
POST /api/sessions - domain, duration, completed_at. Local YYYY-MM-DD dates. An 11pm session belongs to that day, not the next.

Timer completes -> 'Apa yang kamu pelajari?' -> one skippable field. Never a separate screen (D-011). This is what earns the timer its place in the MVP: it attacks capture cost, the exact thing the MVP exists to test (D-038).
docker-compose.prod.yml on the external shared network, Caddy for TLS and hostname routing, provision konku DB + role + vector/pg_trgm extensions. App connects as konku, never as postgres.
Per-database pg_dump -Fc konku (not pg_dumpall) + restic to B2/S3. A backup on the same machine as the database is not a backup. Non-negotiable even in the MVP.

Task Name: Use it daily for two weeks
Description: Not a build task. The MVP exists to answer one question: do you actually write notes and cards? If capture is not happening, fix that before building anything else (D-030).
Signup handler behind ALLOW_SIGNUP, password reset flow. Needs SMTP - the dependency that kept it out of the MVP.

Task Name: Postgres RLS as defense in depth
Description: Row-level security on owned tables. Application-level WHERE user_id scoping stays the primary control; this is belt and braces. Needs SET LOCAL per transaction with a shared pool - correct but not MVP-blocking.
Extend the parser to {{cloze}} and > [!feynman]. Cheap once the stable-ID machinery exists.
Five domains with Indonesian labels, colors, weekly quotas - including coding at quota 0 (D-034). Tag notes, filter lists. Read-only, no editor (D-015).
GET /api/notes?q= via the generated tsvector column, pg_trgm for fuzzy titles.
Set state=mastered at any stage, retiring the card while keeping its history. Sometimes you just know (D-008).
One click to start. Due count surfaced calmly - no red, no alarm.

Task Name: API token auth for machine clients
Description: Bearer tokens so the MCP server can call the HTTP API. Scoped to a user like any other credential. MCP never touches Postgres directly.

Separate Go binary in cmd/konku-mcp exposing notes and review operations as MCP tools over the HTTP API. add_card wraps card.Insert, so agent and UI paths cannot drift (D-033). Zero LLM cost, immediately useful with an existing Claude subscription.
Provider-agnostic interface + Anthropic client. Keys via env, never in the repo.
Model proposes 3-5 cards, user accepts / edits / rejects. Attacks capture cost - the biggest risk to the product. Highest-value AI feature by a wide margin (D-016).
User types recall from memory, model reports what was missed, user still presses ingat/lupa. The model INFORMS, never rates (D-036). The differentiating feature.
Embeddings on notes, similarity endpoint, UI surface. Extension already enabled at DB creation.
Async LLM and embedding work. Evaluate Redis here - the first legitimate reason for it (D-023).
Manifest, service worker, cached shell, offline reads. NOT offline writes - sync with conflict resolution is a project of its own.
Reviews at 30d+ intervals rated ingat vs lupa. 'Kamu masih ingat 38 dari 45 topik dari 3 bulan lalu.' The headline number (D-004).
After 5 consecutive completed sessions the next duration up becomes the pre-selected default. Suggests, never challenges - no celebration, no level-up (D-037).
